accepts.description: Scaffold and implement a new application in this workspace or a named target repo.
Add features onto an existing app only after the operator explicitly names that app.

forbiddenWithoutExplicitAsk: add another site to this environment

chiefOfStaff.invocation: Start or reuse a Cloud Agent on this environment and pass a job object.
chiefOfStaff.handoff: Return a branch or pull request plus a short result summary. Do not wait for Chief of Staff if none is running.
